Name: Pokefy (A Pokemon Mod)
Author: StravaJD
Description:
Pokefy replaces all livestock and various other things (such as critters and TV shows) with Pokemon.

You can choose your horse type, whether or not farm animals, enemies, fish, or pets are replaced with the config file.
I recommend spacechase0's[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][b] [/b]to open up the config in-game, or you can simply open the config in the Pokefy mod folder.

jeNeSaisRien has made a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4250]text companion[/url] to this mod. Many thanks to OwOUwUQwQ for help with the config! And a big thank you to Coupangg for the Tepig, Pignite, Foongus, Genesect, Lampent, Koffing, Drowzee, Froslass, Tyrogue, Shedinja, Noibat and Milotic sprites, and for reworking the fish sprites!

Enjoy and have fun!
